notes: ADR-0185 (owner rulings 2026-09-24; final-model plan Sec.2 amounts): $10,000 booked at 09:30 on the run's first trading day; $500 on the first Friday on or after it, then every 14 days, at 09:30 America/New_York; a Friday without a session rolls to the next trading day at 09:30. A contribution is booked before a decision at the same instant. The phase is global across release segments. Add dated rows to overrides to skip, move ('to'), or replace one scheduled Friday, or to add a one_off deposit or a withdrawal; each is rolled to the next trading day like a contribution. Deposits and withdrawals are external flows, never trading P&L.
